title: Fenced backyard, 3 bd 10 min from DT, Pet friendly
description:
Quiet neighborhood 3 bd w/ easy access to Opry & the airport. 5 miles/ 10 minutes to downtown! 

Centrally located. (11 AM checkout, most are 10) 

Large private fenced in backyard. Dog friendly. 

Luggage storage available. 

Enjoyable Amenities: 

* Easy access to downtown 
* Plentiful parking, including offstreet 
* Fire pit in spacious fenced yard 
* Propane grill  
* Free washer dryer onsite

The space
Home has 3 bedrooms fitted with king sized beds and vanities for getting ready as well as two sleeper sofa in the living room.
This quiet neighborhood is perfect for families or large groups needing a break from the chaos downtown while still being a quick uber to Broadway.

Guest access
Guests will have access to all amenities, including the private backyard. The property includes a fully separate basement unit with its own private entrance. There are no shared indoor living spaces, and guests have full privacy in the main home. The property manager stays in the in the basement unit but is frequently away. If anything comes up during your stay, they are nearby and available to assist if needed.

Other things to note
Private fully fenced backyard with fire pit.
Easy 6 miles to downtown Nashville on a highway with little traffic (typically 10 mins) or $10 uber.
15 minutes from airport
